name: Weak Cosmic Amoeba
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-17: Stranded on Yesterday's Tide

generalAbilities.name: Motion Sense
generalAbilities.description: A cosmic amoeba can sense nearby creatures through vibration and air or water movement.

defensiveAbilities.name: No Breath
defensiveAbilities.description: The cosmic amoeba doesn't breathe and is immune to effects that require breathing (such as inhaled poison).

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
(1d4+2) Bludgeoning Damage], Basic DC 17 Fortitude Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Envelop
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The cosmic amoeba begins its turn with a target its size or smaller Grabbed

Effect The cosmic amoeba maintains the Grab and extends pseudopods to surround the creature and pull it inside the amoeba's body. This thereafter has the same effect as if the amoeba had Engulfed the creature (DC 17 Reflex Saving Throw, 1d6 Acid Damage, Escape dc=17, Rupture 3).

offensiveAbilities.name: Weak Acid
offensiveAbilities.description: A cosmic amoeba's acid damages only organic material—not metal, stone, or other inorganic substances.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
